---
title: "Analysis of government trust and attitudes to vaccines"
author: "Shi Chen"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)

ed_levels<-c(
  "Primary school",
  "Secondary school (age under 15 years old)",
  "GNVQ / GSVQ / GCSE/ SCE standard.", 
  "NVQ1, NVQ2","NVQ3/ SCE Higher Grade/ Advanced GNVQ/ GCE A/AS or similar.",
  "NVQ4 / HNC / HND / Bachelor's degree or similar." ,
  "NVQ5 or post-graduate diploma."                                               
  )

likert_levels <- c("Strongly disagree", "Tend to disagree", "Neither agree nor disagree", "Tend to agree", "Strongly agree")   

d_trustvac <- read_csv(
  '../data/trust-vaccines.csv',
  col_types = cols(
    col_number(),
    col_factor(),
    col_factor(ordered = TRUE,levels = ed_levels),
    col_factor(ordered = TRUE,levels = likert_levels),
    col_factor(ordered = TRUE,levels = likert_levels),
    col_factor(ordered = TRUE,levels = likert_levels),
    col_factor(ordered = TRUE,levels = likert_levels),
    col_factor(ordered = TRUE,levels = likert_levels),
    col_factor(ordered = TRUE,levels = likert_levels),
    col_factor(ordered = TRUE,levels = likert_levels),
    col_factor(ordered = TRUE,levels = likert_levels),
    col_factor(ordered = TRUE,levels = likert_levels),
  ))

d_trustvac<-d_trustvac%>%
  mutate(
    across(
      .cols = c(starts_with('gov'),starts_with('vac')),
      .fns = as.numeric,
      .names = '{.col}_coded'
    )
  )

  
```

## gender
```{r}
d_trustvac %>%
  count(gender_nb)

d_trustvac%>%
  ggplot(aes(x=gender_nb)
  )+geom_bar()


```

## age
```{r}
d_trustvac%>%
  summarise(n=n(),
            M=mean(age)%>% round(digits = 2),
            Mdn=median(age),
            SD=sd(age)%>% round(digits = 2))
d_trustvac %>%
  ggplot(aes(x= age))+geom_histogram(binwidth = 5)
```

## Higest educational qualifications
```{r}
d_trustvac %>%
  count(hhedqual)


d_trustvac %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=hhedqual))+
  geom_bar()+coord_flip()
```

## Descriptive statistics: Likert items
```{r}
tibble(
  d_trustvac$govhonest,
  as.numeric(d_trustvac$govhonest))%>%
  kable()

d_trustvac$govhonest %>%
  as.numeric()%>%
  median(na.rm = TRUE)


trust_likert_summary<-d_trustvac%>%
  select(ends_with('_coded'))%>%
  lapply(
    median,
    na.rm= TRUE
  )
d_trust_likert_summary<- trust_likert_summary%>%
  tibble(
    item= trust_likert_summary%>%names,
    median=trust_likert_summary%>%unlist
  )
d_trust_likert_summary

d_trust_likert_summary%>%
  ggplot(
    aes(x=item,y=median)
  )+
  geom_point()+
  coord_flip()
```
